source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check if system could power on with 1 PSU connected with power cable. Add PSU one by one and check if system could power on.
2. Boot system to OS with full PSU.
3. Remove power cable and PSU of 1st slot. And check if system is still normal or shutdown.
4. Plug PSU and power cable. Check LED of PSU.
5. Repeat steps 3~4 to all the reset of PSU.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. System should be unable to power on with 2PSU
2. System should not shutdowm when hot-remove one PSU

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Check PSU redundant: power-cycle the system while physically adding/removing PSU power cables and verify it powers on with fewer PSUs and does not shut down on hot-remove. A physical power-cabling manipulation the agent cannot do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator adds/removes PSU cables, boots the system and confirms it stays up on one PSU and does not shut down on hot-remove; agent cannot touch PSU cables.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED due one/two-PSU power-on contradiction.

original_test_intent: Validate minimum PSU population and hot-remove redundancy across all slots, but Criterion 1 contradicts the procedure by forbidding power-on with two PSUs after the procedure asks for power-on with one.
original_method: An engineer changes physical PSU/cable population, boots the host and services each PSU while checking continuity and LEDs.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer performs all cable/PSU operations and LED checks; the agent may collect host/BMC power and event evidence.
required_inputs: Correct minimum PSU count and topology
safety_requirements: Do not disconnect a feed/PSU until remaining capacity is proven.
Use a dedicated SUT with console/OOB recovery.
Stop on overload, arcing, thermal or host instability; no automatic retry.
Restore every feed/module and verify sharing.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, capture host continuity, per-PSU power/health, SEL and boot evidence around engineer actions.
Do not operate cables or decide verdict.
engineer_actions: Correct criterion, approve and execute physical matrix.
Observe LEDs, restore topology and issue verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies the manual physical boundary but cannot resolve the source contradiction.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No execution until owner corrects minimum-count semantics; then use read-only BMC/host telemetry as support.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One-PSU/add-one-by-one/full-population/hot-remove steps, contradictory two-PSU criterion and 5/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define required N+M topology and load, then execute an approved slot/feed matrix with continuous power/host/SEL monitoring and full restoration.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Resolves minimum count and binds each action to load/capacity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves boot and hot-remove coverage across all fitted slots.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong removal can abruptly power off the host.

project_override_considerations: Project-specific minimum counts must be explicitly approved and cannot rewrite the Master Source; report only the executed topology.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure expects power-on starting with one PSU and adding units, whereas Criterion 1 says the system must be unable to power on with two PSUs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Minimum viable power population is a core acceptance fact; choosing one interpretation could intentionally violate the other and create a shutdown hazard.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Manual boundary is correct but does not solve criteria.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines exact count/topology decision and no-retry recovery.

review_improvement: Prevents power manipulation until minimum-population and redundancy claims are internally consistent.
independent_technical_reasoning: If one PSU is expected to boot, a blanket prohibition on two-PSU boot is logically incompatible absent an unusual, explicitly defined topology; this cannot be treated as a missing numeric parameter.
